lines.text: A friend who is also a rival.
She's my frenemy, always competing with me.

data.mean: A friend who is also a rival.
data.define: Someone who acts friendly but competes with you.

example.text: She's my frenemy, always competing with me.

misuse.text: Don't call your best friend your 'frenemy'.
misuse.why: It suggests you secretly dislike her.
